local function copy(v)
    if type(v) ~= "table" then
        return v
    end
    local r = {}
    for k, x in pairs(v) do
        r[k] = copy(x)
    end
    return r
end
local function words(s)
    local a = {}
    for x in s:gmatch("%S+") do
        a[#a + 1] = x
    end
    return a
end
local function initial(score)
    local own = {}
    for p = 0, 25 do
        own[p] = 0
    end
    own[24], own[13], own[8], own[6] = 2, 5, 3, 5
    return {
        pos = {copy(own), copy(own)},
        side = 1,
        cube = 1,
        owner = 0,
        pending = false,
        over = false,
        score = copy(score or {0, 0})
    }
end
local function color(x)
    return x == 1 and "W" or "B"
end
local function positionKey(pos)
    local a = {}
    for x = 1, 2 do
        for p = 0, 25 do
            a[#a + 1] = pos[x][p]
        end
    end
    return table.concat(a, ",")
end
local function pairLess(a, b)
    return a[1] > b[1] or a[1] == b[1] and a[2] > b[2]
end
local function keyLess(a, b)
    for i = 1, math.min(#a, #b) do
        if a[i][1] ~= b[i][1] or a[i][2] ~= b[i][2] then
            return pairLess(a[i], b[i])
        end
    end
    return #a > #b
end
local function notation(moves, hits)
    local key = copy(moves)
    table.sort(key, pairLess)
    while true do
        local ai, bi
        for i, a in ipairs(key) do
            if a[2] > 0 and not hits[a[2]] then
                for j, b in ipairs(key) do
                    if b[1] == a[2] then
                        ai, bi = i, j
                        break
                    end
                end
            end
            if ai then
                break
            end
        end
        if not ai then
            break
        end
        local a, b = key[ai], key[bi]
        table.remove(key, math.max(ai, bi))
        table.remove(key, math.min(ai, bi))
        key[#key + 1] = {a[1], b[2]}
        table.sort(key, pairLess)
    end
    local parts, marked, i = {}, {}, 1
    while i <= #key do
        local s, t = key[i][1], key[i][2]
        local j = i + 1
        while j <= #key and key[j][1] == s and key[j][2] == t do
            j = j + 1
        end
        local text = (s == 25 and "bar" or s) .. "/" .. (t == 0 and "off" or t)
        if hits[t] and not marked[t] then
            text = text .. "*"
            marked[t] = true
        end
        if j - i > 1 then
            text = text .. "(" .. j - i .. ")"
        end
        parts[#parts + 1] = text
        i = j
    end
    return key, #parts == 0 and "none" or table.concat(parts, " ")
end
local function enumerate(pos, side, d1, d2)
    local all = {}
    local dice = d1 == d2 and {d1, d1, d1, d1} or {d1, d2}
    local function visit(board, remaining, moves, hits, used)
        local key, text = notation(moves, hits)
        all[#all + 1] = {
            pos = board,
            key = key,
            text = text,
            count = #moves,
            used = used,
            id = positionKey(board)
        }
        local own, opponent = board[side], board[3 - side]
        local tried = {}
        for di, d in ipairs(remaining) do
            if not tried[d] then
                tried[d] = true
                local sources = {}
                if own[25] > 0 then
                    sources = {25}
                else
                    for p = 1, 24 do
                        if own[p] > 0 then
                            sources[#sources + 1] = p
                        end
                    end
                end
                for _, s in ipairs(sources) do
                    local t, valid = math.max(0, s - d), true
                    if t > 0 then
                        valid = opponent[25 - t] < 2
                    else
                        if own[25] > 0 then
                            valid = false
                        end
                        for p = 7, 24 do
                            if own[p] > 0 then
                                valid = false
                            end
                        end
                        if s < d then
                            for p = s + 1, 6 do
                                if own[p] > 0 then
                                    valid = false
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    if valid then
                        local nextBoard, nextMoves, nextHits, nextUsed, rest =
                            copy(board),
                            copy(moves),
                            copy(hits),
                            copy(used),
                            copy(remaining)
                        nextBoard[side][s] = nextBoard[side][s] - 1
                        nextBoard[side][t] = nextBoard[side][t] + 1
                        if t > 0 and opponent[25 - t] == 1 then
                            nextBoard[3 - side][25 - t] = 0
                            nextBoard[3 - side][25] = nextBoard[3 - side][25] + 1
                            nextHits[t] = true
                        end
                        nextMoves[#nextMoves + 1] = {s, t}
                        nextUsed[#nextUsed + 1] = d
                        table.remove(rest, di)
                        visit(nextBoard, rest, nextMoves, nextHits, nextUsed)
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    visit(pos, dice, {}, {}, {})
    local maximum, larger = 0, false
    for _, p in ipairs(all) do
        maximum = math.max(maximum, p.count)
    end
    if maximum == 1 and d1 ~= d2 then
        for _, p in ipairs(all) do
            if p.count == 1 and p.used[1] == math.max(d1, d2) then
                larger = true
            end
        end
    end
    local unique, legal = {}, {}
    for _, p in ipairs(all) do
        if p.count == maximum and (not larger or p.used[1] == math.max(d1, d2)) and not unique[p.id] then
            unique[p.id] = true
            legal[#legal + 1] = p
        end
    end
    table.sort(
        legal,
        function(a, b)
            return keyLess(a.key, b.key)
        end
    )
    return legal, all, maximum
end
local function pips(own)
    local n = 0
    for p = 1, 25 do
        n = n + p * own[p]
    end
    return n
end
local function evaluation(pos, side)
    local own, opp = pos[side], pos[3 - side]
    local p, s, h, r, a, run = pips(opp) - pips(own), 0, 0, 0, 0, 0
    for point = 1, 24 do
        if own[point] == 1 then
            local distances = {}
            for q = 0, point - 1 do
                if opp[25 - q] > 0 then
                    distances[point - q] = true
                end
            end
            for d1 = 1, 6 do
                for d2 = 1, 6 do
                    if
                        distances[d1] or distances[d2] or distances[d1 + d2] or
                            (d1 == d2 and (distances[3 * d1] or distances[4 * d1]))
                     then
                        s = s + 1
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        if own[point] >= 2 then
            if point <= 6 then
                h = h + 1
            end
            if point >= 19 then
                a = a + 1
            end
            run = run + 1
            r = math.max(r, run)
        else
            run = 0
        end
    end
    local g = opp[25] - own[25]
    return {2 * p - s + 4 * h + 3 * r + 3 * a + 6 * g, p, s, h, r, a, g}
end
local function keith(own)
    local n =
        pips(own) + 2 * math.max(own[1] - 1, 0) + math.max(own[2] - 1, 0) + math.max(own[3] - 3, 0)
    for p = 4, 6 do
        if own[p] == 0 then
            n = n + 1
        end
    end
    return n
end
local function contact(pos)
    local w, b = 0, 25
    for p = 1, 24 do
        if pos[1][p] > 0 then
            w = math.max(w, p)
        end
        if pos[2][p] > 0 then
            b = math.min(b, 25 - p)
        end
    end
    if pos[1][25] > 0 then
        w = 25
    end
    if pos[2][25] > 0 then
        b = 0
    end
    return w > b
end
local function cubeDecision(state, forbidden)
    local x = state.side
    if state.owner == 3 - x or state.cube == 64 or forbidden then
        return "unavailable"
    end
    if contact(state.pos) then
        local e = evaluation(state.pos, x)[1]
        if e < 60 then
            return "no double"
        end
        return e <= 100 and "double take" or "double drop"
    end
    local v = 8 * keith(state.pos[x]) - 7 * keith(state.pos[3 - x])
    local limit = state.owner == 0 and 28 or 21
    if v > limit then
        return "no double"
    end
    return v >= 14 and "double take" or "double drop"
end
local function endGame(state, winner, kind)
    if not kind then
        local opp = state.pos[3 - winner]
        local back = opp[25] > 0
        for p = 19, 24 do
            if opp[p] > 0 then
                back = true
            end
        end
        kind = opp[0] > 0 and "single" or (back and "backgammon" or "gammon")
    end
    local multiplier = ({single = 1, gammon = 2, backgammon = 3, drop = 1})[kind]
    local points = multiplier * state.cube
    state.over, state.pending = true, false
    state.score[winner] = state.score[winner] + points
    return {winner, kind, points}
end
local function applyPlay(state, play)
    state.pos = copy(play.pos)
    if state.pos[state.side][0] == 15 then
        return endGame(state, state.side)
    end
    state.side = 3 - state.side
end
local function ranked(legal, side)
    local result = {}
    for i, p in ipairs(legal) do
        result[#result + 1] = {evaluation(p.pos, side)[1], i, p}
    end
    table.sort(
        result,
        function(a, b)
            return a[1] > b[1] or a[1] == b[1] and a[2] < b[2]
        end
    )
    return result
end
local function validPoint(s)
    return s and s:match("^[1-9]%d?$") and tonumber(s) <= 24
end
local function parsePlay(tokens)
    if #tokens == 1 and tokens[1] == "none" then
        return {}
    end
    local moves = {}
    local function syntax()
        error("ILLEGAL syntax", 0)
    end
    for _, token in ipairs(tokens) do
        local path, k = token:match("^(.-)%(([234])%)$")
        if not path then
            path, k = token, 1
        else
            k = tonumber(k)
        end
        local fields = {}
        for field in (path .. "/"):gmatch("(.-)/") do
            fields[#fields + 1] = field
        end
        if #fields < 2 then
            syntax()
        end
        local values = {}
        for i, word in ipairs(fields) do
            if i == 1 then
                if word == "bar" then
                    values[i] = 25
                elseif validPoint(word) then
                    values[i] = tonumber(word)
                else
                    syntax()
                end
            else
                if word == "off" then
                    values[i] = 0
                else
                    local point = word:gsub("%*$", "")
                    if not validPoint(point) then
                        syntax()
                    end
                    values[i] = tonumber(point)
                end
                if values[i - 1] <= values[i] then
                    syntax()
                end
            end
        end
        for i = 1, #values - 1 do
            for _ = 1, k do
                moves[#moves + 1] = {values[i], values[i + 1]}
            end
        end
    end
    return moves
end
local function randomStream(seed)
    local value = seed
    return function()
        value = value * 48271 % 2147483647
        return value
    end
end
local function resultLine(result)
    return "result " .. color(result[1]) .. " " .. result[2] .. " " .. result[3]
end
local function simulate(state, rng, strategies, opening, target, scores, crawford, verbose)
    state = copy(state)
    local dice
    local function die()
        return rng() % 6 + 1
    end
    if opening then
        repeat
            dice = {die(), die()}
        until dice[1] ~= dice[2]
        state.side = dice[1] > dice[2] and 1 or 2
    end
    local first, turn, plays = state.side, 1, 0
    while true do
        local x = state.side
        if not opening or turn ~= 1 then
            local forbidden = target and (crawford or scores[x] + state.cube >= target)
            local decision = cubeDecision(state, forbidden)
            if decision == "double take" or decision == "double drop" then
                if verbose then
                    print(turn .. " " .. color(x) .. " doubles " .. state.cube * 2)
                end
                if decision == "double drop" then
                    if verbose then
                        print(turn .. " " .. color(3 - x) .. " drops")
                    end
                    return endGame(state, x, "drop"), plays, first
                end
                if verbose then
                    print(turn .. " " .. color(3 - x) .. " takes")
                end
                state.cube, state.owner = state.cube * 2, 3 - x
            end
            dice = {die(), die()}
        end
        local legal = enumerate(state.pos, x, dice[1], dice[2])
        local play
        if strategies[x] == "FIRST" then
            play = legal[1]
        elseif strategies[x] == "RANDOM" then
            play = legal[rng() % #legal + 1]
        else
            play = ranked(legal, x)[1][3]
        end
        if verbose then
            print(turn .. " " .. color(x) .. " " .. dice[1] .. "-" .. dice[2] .. " " .. play.text)
        end
        local result = applyPlay(state, play)
        plays = plays + 1
        if result then
            return result, plays, first
        end
        turn = turn + 1
    end
end
local function numeric(s, lo, hi)
    return s and s:match("^%d+$") and tonumber(s) >= lo and tonumber(s) <= hi
end
local noargs, known, limited, pendingLimited = {}, {}, {}, {}
for _, c in ipairs(words("NEW SHOW BOARD PIPS RACE EVAL SHOTS CUBE DOUBLE TAKE DROP SCORE HISTORY")) do
    noargs[c], known[c] = true, true
end
for _, c in ipairs(words("POS MOVES PLAY AUTO HINT RESIGN UNDO REDO GAME MATCH STATS")) do
    known[c] = true
end
for _, c in ipairs(words("RACE MOVES PLAY AUTO HINT EVAL SHOTS CUBE DOUBLE TAKE DROP RESIGN GAME")) do
    limited[c] = true
end
for _, c in ipairs(words("PLAY AUTO CUBE DOUBLE RESIGN GAME")) do
    pendingLimited[c] = true
end
local state, history, redo = initial(), {}, {}
local function requireThat(valid, message)
    if not valid then
        error(message, 0)
    end
end
local function run(line)
    local a = words(line)
    local cmd = table.remove(a, 1)
    requireThat(known[cmd], "ERROR unknown command")
    local valid, pos = true, nil
    if noargs[cmd] then
        valid = #a == 0
    elseif cmd == "POS" then
        local points = {}
        for v in (a[1] or ""):gmatch("[^,]+") do
            points[#points + 1] = tonumber(v)
        end
        valid =
            #a == 4 and #points == 24 and numeric(a[2], 0, 15) and numeric(a[3], 0, 15) and
            (a[4] == "W" or a[4] == "B")
        if valid then
            pos = initial().pos
            for x = 1, 2 do
                for p = 0, 25 do
                    pos[x][p] = 0
                end
            end
            for p, v in ipairs(points) do
                if v > 0 then
                    pos[1][p] = v
                else
                    pos[2][25 - p] = -v
                end
            end
            pos[1][25], pos[2][25] = tonumber(a[2]), tonumber(a[3])
            for x = 1, 2 do
                local count = 0
                for p = 1, 25 do
                    count = count + pos[x][p]
                end
                pos[x][0] = 15 - count
                if pos[x][0] < 0 or pos[x][0] > 14 then
                    valid = false
                end
            end
        end
    elseif cmd == "MOVES" or cmd == "AUTO" or cmd == "PLAY" or cmd == "HINT" then
        valid = numeric(a[1], 1, 6) and numeric(a[2], 1, 6)
        if cmd == "PLAY" then
            valid = valid and #a >= 3
        elseif cmd == "HINT" then
            valid = valid and #a == 3 and numeric(a[3], 1, 1000)
        else
            valid = valid and #a == 2
        end
    elseif cmd == "RESIGN" then
        valid = #a == 1 and (a[1] == "single" or a[1] == "gammon" or a[1] == "backgammon")
    elseif cmd == "UNDO" or cmd == "REDO" then
        valid = #a == 1 and numeric(a[1], 1, 1000)
    elseif cmd == "GAME" then
        local strategies = {BEST = true, FIRST = true, RANDOM = true}
        valid = #a == 3 and numeric(a[1], 1, 2147483646) and strategies[a[2]] and strategies[a[3]]
    elseif cmd == "MATCH" or cmd == "STATS" then
        valid =
            #a == 2 and numeric(a[1], 1, cmd == "MATCH" and 15 or 50) and
            numeric(a[2], 1, 2147483646)
    end
    requireThat(valid, cmd == "POS" and "ERROR bad position" or "ERROR bad arguments")
    requireThat(not limited[cmd] or not state.over, "ERROR game over")
    requireThat(not pendingLimited[cmd] or not state.pending, "ERROR double pending")
    local side = state.side
    if cmd == "NEW" or cmd == "POS" then
        state = initial(state.score)
        if cmd == "POS" then
            state.pos, state.side = pos, a[4] == "W" and 1 or 2
        end
        history, redo = {}, {}
        print("OK")
    elseif cmd == "SHOW" then
        local points = {}
        for p = 1, 24 do
            points[p] = state.pos[1][p] - state.pos[2][25 - p]
        end
        print(
            "POS " ..
                table.concat(points, ",") ..
                    " " .. state.pos[1][25] .. " " .. state.pos[2][25] .. " " .. color(side)
        )
    elseif cmd == "BOARD" then
        local function boardLine(top, row)
            local fields = {}
            for i = 1, 12 do
                local p = top and i + 12 or 13 - i
                local value = p
                if row then
                    local w, b = state.pos[1][p], state.pos[2][25 - p]
                    local count = math.max(w, b)
                    value =
                        row == 5 and count > 5 and count or
                        (count >= row and (w > 0 and "W" or "B") or ".")
                end
                fields[#fields + 1] = string.format("%3s", tostring(value))
                if i == 6 then
                    fields[#fields + 1] = " |"
                end
            end
            print(table.concat(fields))
        end
        boardLine(true)
        for row = 1, 5 do
            boardLine(true, row)
        end
        local owner = state.owner == 0 and "center" or color(state.owner)
        local status =
            state.over and "game over" or
            color(side) .. (state.pending and " doubles" or " to move")
        print(
            "bar W" ..
                state.pos[1][25] ..
                    " B" ..
                        state.pos[2][25] ..
                            " | off W" ..
                                state.pos[1][0] ..
                                    " B" ..
                                        state.pos[2][0] ..
                                            " | cube " ..
                                                state.cube .. " " .. owner .. " | " .. status
        )
        for row = 5, 1, -1 do
            boardLine(false, row)
        end
        boardLine(false)
    elseif cmd == "PIPS" then
        print("pips W " .. pips(state.pos[1]) .. " B " .. pips(state.pos[2]))
    elseif cmd == "RACE" then
        print(
            contact(state.pos) and "contact" or
                "race W " .. keith(state.pos[1]) .. " B " .. keith(state.pos[2])
        )
    elseif cmd == "EVAL" then
        local labels, values =
            {"eval", "pips", "blots", "home", "prime", "anchors", "bar"},
            evaluation(state.pos, side)
        local parts = {}
        for i, label in ipairs(labels) do
            parts[#parts + 1] = label .. " " .. values[i]
        end
        print(table.concat(parts, " "))
    elseif cmd == "MOVES" or cmd == "HINT" or cmd == "AUTO" or cmd == "PLAY" then
        local d1, d2 = tonumber(a[1]), tonumber(a[2])
        local legal, all, maximum = enumerate(state.pos, side, d1, d2)
        if cmd == "MOVES" then
            for _, p in ipairs(legal) do
                print(p.text)
            end
            print("total " .. #legal)
        elseif cmd == "HINT" then
            local list = ranked(legal, side)
            for i = 1, math.min(#list, tonumber(a[3])) do
                print(list[i][1] .. " " .. list[i][3].text)
            end
        else
            local play, value
            if cmd == "AUTO" then
                local best = ranked(legal, side)[1]
                value, play = best[1], best[3]
            else
                local tokens = {}
                for i = 3, #a do
                    tokens[#tokens + 1] = a[i]
                end
                local moves = parsePlay(tokens)
                local final, destinations = copy(state.pos), {}
                for _, m in ipairs(moves) do
                    final[side][m[1]] = final[side][m[1]] - 1
                    final[side][m[2]] = final[side][m[2]] + 1
                    if m[2] > 0 then
                        destinations[m[2]] = true
                    end
                end
                for t in pairs(destinations) do
                    if state.pos[3 - side][25 - t] == 1 then
                        final[3 - side][25 - t] = 0
                        final[3 - side][25] = final[3 - side][25] + 1
                    end
                end
                for p = 1, 25 do
                    requireThat(final[side][p] >= 0, "ILLEGAL no checker")
                end
                if final[side][25] > 0 then
                    for _, m in ipairs(moves) do
                        requireThat(m[1] == 25, "ILLEGAL bar")
                    end
                end
                for t in pairs(destinations) do
                    requireThat(state.pos[3 - side][25 - t] < 2, "ILLEGAL blocked")
                end
                local bearing = false
                for _, m in ipairs(moves) do
                    if m[2] == 0 then
                        bearing = true
                    end
                end
                if bearing then
                    requireThat(final[side][25] == 0, "ILLEGAL bear-off")
                    for p = 7, 24 do
                        requireThat(final[side][p] == 0, "ILLEGAL bear-off")
                    end
                end
                local key = positionKey(final)
                for _, p in ipairs(legal) do
                    if p.id == key then
                        play = p
                        break
                    end
                end
                if not play then
                    local possible, fewer = false, false
                    for _, p in ipairs(all) do
                        if p.id == key then
                            possible = true
                            if p.count < maximum then
                                fewer = true
                            end
                        end
                    end
                    requireThat(possible, "ILLEGAL impossible")
                    error(fewer and "ILLEGAL too few dice" or "ILLEGAL larger die required", 0)
                end
            end
            local before = copy(state)
            local result = applyPlay(state, play)
            print("OK " .. play.text .. (cmd == "AUTO" and " eval " .. value or ""))
            if result then
                print(resultLine(result))
            end
            history[#history + 1] = {
                color(side) .. " " .. d1 .. "-" .. d2 .. " " .. play.text,
                before,
                copy(state)
            }
            redo = {}
        end
    elseif cmd == "SHOTS" then
        local blots, counts = {}, {}
        for p = 24, 1, -1 do
            if state.pos[side][p] == 1 then
                blots[#blots + 1] = p
                counts[p] = 0
            end
        end
        local total, rolls = 0, {}
        for d1 = 6, 1, -1 do
            for d2 = d1, 1, -1 do
                local legal = enumerate(state.pos, 3 - side, d1, d2)
                local hit = {}
                for _, p in ipairs(blots) do
                    for _, play in ipairs(legal) do
                        if play.pos[side][p] == 0 then
                            hit[#hit + 1] = p
                            break
                        end
                    end
                end
                if #hit > 0 then
                    local weight = d1 == d2 and 1 or 2
                    total = total + weight
                    rolls[#rolls + 1] = d1 .. "-" .. d2
                    for _, p in ipairs(hit) do
                        counts[p] = counts[p] + weight
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        print("shots " .. total .. "/36" .. (#rolls > 0 and " " .. table.concat(rolls, " ") or ""))
        for _, p in ipairs(blots) do
            print("blot " .. p .. " " .. counts[p] .. "/36")
        end
    elseif cmd == "CUBE" then
        print("cube " .. cubeDecision(state))
    elseif cmd == "DOUBLE" then
        requireThat(state.owner ~= 3 - side and state.cube ~= 64, "ERROR cube unavailable")
        state.pending, redo = true, {}
        print("OK double " .. state.cube * 2)
    elseif cmd == "TAKE" or cmd == "DROP" then
        requireThat(state.pending, "ERROR no double")
        state.pending, redo = false, {}
        if cmd == "TAKE" then
            state.cube, state.owner = state.cube * 2, 3 - side
            print("OK take " .. state.cube .. " " .. color(state.owner))
        else
            print("OK drop")
            print(resultLine(endGame(state, side, "drop")))
        end
    elseif cmd == "RESIGN" then
        redo = {}
        print("OK resign")
        print(resultLine(endGame(state, 3 - side, a[1])))
    elseif cmd == "SCORE" then
        print("score W " .. state.score[1] .. " B " .. state.score[2])
    elseif cmd == "HISTORY" then
        print("history " .. #history)
        for i, entry in ipairs(history) do
            print(i .. " " .. entry[1])
        end
    elseif cmd == "UNDO" or cmd == "REDO" then
        local n = tonumber(a[1])
        if cmd == "UNDO" then
            requireThat(n <= #history, "ERROR cannot undo")
            local entries = {}
            local start = #history - n + 1
            for i = start, #history do
                entries[#entries + 1] = history[i]
            end
            state = copy(entries[1][2])
            for i = #history, start, -1 do
                history[i] = nil
            end
            for i = #entries, 1, -1 do
                table.insert(redo, 1, entries[i])
            end
        else
            requireThat(n <= #redo, "ERROR cannot redo")
            local entries = {}
            for _ = 1, n do
                entries[#entries + 1] = table.remove(redo, 1)
            end
            state = copy(entries[#entries][3])
            for _, e in ipairs(entries) do
                history[#history + 1] = e
            end
        end
        print("OK")
    elseif cmd == "GAME" then
        local result =
            simulate(
            state,
            randomStream(tonumber(a[1])),
            {a[2], a[3]},
            false,
            nil,
            nil,
            false,
            true
        )
        print(resultLine(result))
    elseif cmd == "MATCH" or cmd == "STATS" then
        local n, rng = tonumber(a[1]), randomStream(tonumber(a[2]))
        local points, turns, game, crawfordUsed = {0, 0}, 0, 0, false
        local kinds, outcomes = {"single", "gammon", "backgammon", "drop"}, {}
        for _, k in ipairs(kinds) do
            outcomes[k] = {0, 0}
        end
        while cmd == "STATS" and game < n or cmd == "MATCH" and math.max(points[1], points[2]) < n do
            game = game + 1
            local crawford =
                cmd == "MATCH" and not crawfordUsed and math.max(points[1], points[2]) == n - 1
            if crawford then
                crawfordUsed = true
            end
            local result, played, first =
                simulate(
                initial(),
                rng,
                {"BEST", "BEST"},
                true,
                cmd == "MATCH" and n or nil,
                points,
                crawford,
                false
            )
            local winner, kind, value = result[1], result[2], result[3]
            points[winner] = points[winner] + value
            outcomes[kind][winner] = outcomes[kind][winner] + 1
            turns = turns + played
            if cmd == "MATCH" then
                print(
                    "game " ..
                        game ..
                            (crawford and " crawford" or "") ..
                                " start " ..
                                    color(first) ..
                                        " turns " ..
                                            played ..
                                                " " ..
                                                    resultLine(result) ..
                                                        " score " .. points[1] .. "-" .. points[2]
                )
            end
        end
        if cmd == "MATCH" then
            print(
                "match " .. color(points[1] >= n and 1 or 2) .. " " .. points[1] .. "-" .. points[2]
            )
        else
            for _, k in ipairs(kinds) do
                print(k .. " W " .. outcomes[k][1] .. " B " .. outcomes[k][2])
            end
            print("points W " .. points[1] .. " B " .. points[2])
            print("turns " .. turns)
        end
    end
end
local n = tonumber(io.read())
for _ = 1, n do
    local ok, message = pcall(run, io.read())
    if not ok then
        print(message)
    end
end
